findings.text: follow-on: _write_json hand-rolls the atomic JSON write (NamedTemporaryFile + json.dump + os.replace) that the repository already owns as reckon/_store.py:584 write_json_atomically (78 call sites across reckon/), a capability fork that does not extend the owner; it should call write_json_atomically(path, value, indent=2, sort_keys=True).

follow-on: the plan's done-when requires the test to assert the real crew home is untouched; the fixture asserts the patched home resolves under tmp_path before any write but adds no assertion that the real crew home is unchanged afterward.
